title: rest: /meta does not negotiate the request locale, so en-US reads the default locale while other readers read en
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35384 (PR #36464). Measured by the #35384 dev. Filed by the seat. Parent: #35384.

## What happens

With `sourceLocale: en`, `defaultLocale: zh-CN` and an `en` translation pack held, a request for `en-US` gets different object labels from different doors:
- `/meta` answers 客户: it looks the raw tag `en-US` up, finds no pack, and falls back to the default locale.
- objectql, plugin-security and the readers #36464 moves onto `translateObject` answer Account: they negotiate the tag to `en` first.

So one page can show 客户 in a header and Account in a refusal or audit line for the same request.

## To do

1. Make the `/meta` read (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) negotiate the request tag the way the other readers do before it picks a pack. No spec change.
2. Pin: an `en-US` request with only an `en` pack reads Account from `/meta`, and a request for a locale with no pack at all still reads the default locale.

## Acceptance

- For the same request, `/meta` and the server-side readers name an object with the same label.

## Grade
p2 · domain:rest. Two doors disagree on one label.
